question.text: The mean age of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn></math> teachers in a school is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>40</mn></math> years. A teacher retires at the age of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn></math> years and a new teacher is appointed in his place. If the mean age of the teachers in this school now is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>39</mn></math> years, then the age (in years) of the newly appointed teacher is

solution.text:
